reviews.text: Bayou City Veterinary Hospital is the best! We had to spend extra time there today due to an issue at our apartment, and the entire team was so accommodating. Dr. Foster and Sofia were amazingly gentle and caring with my cats, and the front desk staff was super friendly. So thankful to have them in the neighborhood—highly recommended!
Dr. Flores and her team do an amazing job of taking care of both of our fur babies!

So a skin issue has been going on with my dog for months. I tried and tried.. My veterinarian thought out of the box and 2 1/2 weeks later Riley is a completely new dog. I really can’t think this place more and I will travel here even with the new move. I’m about to have she is Godsend  and thank y’all so much for getting my dog back healthy.

Dr. Kyle always takes such great care of my dogs, and I’m so thankful to have someone I trust so much. One of my dogs just had surgery, and everything went incredibly smoothly from beginning to end.
She’s responsive, knowledgeable, calming, and always has a solution and helpful guidance. It truly makes a difference having a vet who cares this much. Highly recommend Dr. Kyle if you want to feel confident your pets are in great hands.

I just left the clinic had a bad experience everything seems fine at first I brought in my friend's Pup for a simple hotspot on her paw then I noticed that the doctor started giving me more medication than she really needed  it was a simple hotspot all she needed was some antibiotics or even a topical she gave her antibiotics that should have been enough but instead she insisted on also sending her home with steroids which is bad for the liver and kidneys the owner declined it more than once because I called her and yet the doctor called her again and convinced her that she needed them even though I know she didn't because it was a simple hotspot which would have dried up on its own with antibiotics don't take your dogs there they like to overmedicate that's how they make their money don't recommend these people at all nice clinic however

The vets here are knowledgeable and I feel confident in their care, especially in urgent situations. However, my experience with the rest of the staff has been less consistent. Communication can be slow, and I have often needed to call multiple times to have prescriptions sent to my preferred pharmacy. Overall, the service does not feel as attentive or personal as I would expect, particularly given the pricing. If you are looking to build an ongoing relationship with a team who really knows your pet, this may not be the best fit. I would trust them in an emergency, but for routine care, there are better options.

Incredible veterinarians, they are kind, explain things well and take their time with each pet, never rushing. Prices are fair and staff is wonderful! Easy to get an appointment and plentiful parking is a plus! Dr. Diehl and Dr. Foster are incredible!
Beautiful hospital really nice staff and management. Amazing business model superior service
A full, caring and friendly check up made, including vaccine, tick etc... update. Lovely staff.

I used to take my dogs to Bayou City Veterinary Hospital for all their shots, exams, etc. I started with one dog, and then adopted s second younger dog. The second one ended up with heartworms, and the clinic guided me on her treatment. I never had any complaints about the treatment my dogs received.

However, I stopped going ot them because of how I was treated regarding billing and cost. One day (after my younger dog completed the heartworm treatment) I was directed to bring her in for followup testing and examination. This was in 2021 or 2022 and I was having a hard time money-wise, so I asked them to let me know a couple days ahead of the appointment how much I should expect to pay.  They let me know via mail the evening before our appointment that it was over $400 . I seem to remember it was over $600, but I can't find the invoice to verify. It was a lot for me at the time, and with almost no notice.  Looking back, I think some of the more expensive things we did were elective, and I didn't know that/didn't even realize i could ask, and certainly no one told me. What stopped me from going back was how I'd also paid for some medicine for my older dog for ~$30. When I couldn't pay the whole big vet bill at the conclusion of the appointment, the clinic wouldn't release my other dog's (paid) medicine to me. Having gone there for years for two dogs, I just didn't appreciate that.  I switched to Oak Forest Vet Hospital after this, which is good because now I have 3 adopted doggos.
Run don't walk from this place. The owners are highly unethical. Rude and unprofessional.

Dr. Diehl is amazing—she explains everything so well.  Dr. D is caring and always conservative, balancing our pups’ (multiple) needs with a sensible approach.  She is so supportive, and we really feel we can rely upon her advice when it comes to treatment.  We have been bringing our pets here for a couple of years, and even though they are slightly more expensive than our previous vet, it’s well worth the excellent care Dr. D provides for our fur babies.
Dr Diehl is amazing and compassionate. She's been so supportive of our furry family from puppihood through senior care. Staff is attentive and thorough.

Not a great experience.

The doctors are great, but the staff is unfriendly and unresponsive.

If you ever need a vet, come here and ask for Dr. Diehl. We unexpectedly had to bring our pup Frankie in when he wasn't feeling well and they squeezed us in with her. We had never met her before but she instantly made us feel more comfortable. She listened to all of our concerns and came up with a plan keeping the cost of each test in mind, which was so so helpful. We ended up having to put our pup down that day and she really did make an incredibly painful experience a little more peaceful. She was so kind, patient and thorough about what was going to happen, how it was going to happen and when. She never made us feel rushed and assured us at every step of the way. Dr. Diehl treated Frankie with so much love and respect until his last moments. I will be forever be so grateful that she was the one who was able to help us say goodbye.
Go to affordable pet clinic. Estimate was 2K for staples. They did it for 175

The best! We have been taking our animals to Bayou City Vets for a decade and wouldn't have it any other way.

The staff is highly competent, thoughtful, and friendly. Docs are amazing. Compassion and skill all around.

From routine care to medical emergencies to complex diagnostic workups, we have always been so grateful for the level of service we receive from the team.

It's the only clinical setting our cats, frenchie, and English bulldogs have never exhibited anxiety over (and that's saying a lot for our crew)!

Absolutely overinflated prices for this clinic. They do a good job, but their prices are outrageous. If you purchase medicine here, be prepared to atleast pay a premium. Recently purchased a medicine here for my dog and they charged almost 400% more (NOT 40%, 400!!!). They seem to always find something to bill with each visit.

I took my dog Bo in for a visit & had a great experience with Dr. Kyle & her vet tech. They were very friendly & did a very thorough job on my dog! They even were able to tell me prices as they went and didn’t pressure me into anything. I believe they provided my dog with great care and I will definitely be using them in the future!

The veterinarians and staff are well-trained, knowledgeable, polite, and caring. The facilities are modern, extremely well kept, and clean. I can always rest assured that my dog is in the best hands and that Dr. Kyle and everyone at Bayou City is committed to her health, happiness, and comfort.

I switched to Bayou City after mixed results at various other veterinarians in the area and finally found our forever doc!!
Every time I go in I have an amazing experience. The doctors and the staff are amazing.
Extremely friendly staff and very nice facilities.
Dr. Diehl & Dr. Foster always take such good care of our doggies. The staff is very sweet and kind!
My cat a ribbon. I was able to see the vet right away, and they took such good care of my sweet girl.

Posting 4 stars because because they accommodated my dog during Beryl, Dr. Diehl is amazing, and the groomers are amazing.

Took off one star, and updating my review because of horrible interactions with a bitter woman that works their front desk (Karina).  I decided to update this after three interactions with Karina.

I have personally dropped my pet off a handful of times and the last time I was late due to a fatality that occurred on 610  on 1/08/2025 (I updated them of the situation). The appointment was cancelled-not a big deal.

I called today 1/24/2025 to schedule a treatment/vaccine and when I called mentioned my pet was due for either a vaccine or check up (I did not have the e-mail pulled up). As Karina pulled up my pet's chart in a very condescending tone she mentioned: "That is not a vaccine since I do not see that he needs vaccines". My response: "I understand, but the e-mail description mentions both which is why I mentioned it to you." Unnecessary.  That was then scheduled, so I then asked about a grooming appointment and she mentioned I could not be late and she would schedule the appointment but that I could drop off my dog at anytime in the morning. I then told her I would be bringing the dog at 8:30, she tells me AGAIN to not be late. I then tell her "Okay, but I can drop him off before then, so I plan on taking him around 8:30 so give me an appointment at 9 to be safe." She then tells me: "Do not be late". The point is for her to give me an appointment that aligns with my drop off time that was previously mentioned. Maybe I should spell this out for her?

Either, she is too dense to comprehend basic scheduling, or just a bitter human being. I have scheduled with other groomers, just to avoid interactions with this woman. However, I am a return customer because her trash attitude will not deter me from bringing my pet to a place he has known for several years.

I am including a snippet of their e-mail reminders that go out.
